text:
Maya: Quick sync — we have a joint launch with CloudCatalog. Scope: cloud catalog listing, a short benchmark blog, a joint webinar, and inbound lead routing. Target launch in 3 weeks. Who can own each piece?
Alejandro: I can own the cloud catalog assets (listing copy, screenshots, SKU matrix). Will draft marketplace checklist by EOD Fri.
Sophie: I'll write the benchmark narrative + blog draft, and own the webinar narrative. Need anonymized workload + latency/cost numbers from eng. @Ben can you pull?
Ben: Yep — I can get p50/p95/p99 latency, cost-per-1k tokens, and the batch/seq config we ran. I'll upload CSV + short notes to the drive folder: https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/cc-launch by Thu.
Maya: Thanks. Webinar date options: Apr 18 or Apr 25. Partner asked for an afternoon PT slot. Thoughts?
Alejandro: Partner PM prefers Apr 25 (afternoon PT). Can we lock Apr 25 1:30pm PT?
Sophie: Apr 25 works. For webinar messaging, propose we A/B test two CTAs: 1) "Cut inference cost by ~40% with smart batching" and 2) "Run production LLMs with predictable latency" — route each CTA to a different landing page to measure conversion.
Lucy: I'll build two landing pages in HubSpot and add UTMs. Proposed UTMs: utm_medium=partner, utm_source=cloudcatalog, utm_campaign=cc-apr25-ab. Also will wire form field: lead_source_detail=cloudcatalog_listing.
Maya: Perfect. Inbound routing: marketplace leads -> Partner Marketing queue; webinar signups -> SDR queue; marketplace demo requests -> Partner Sales cue. Can we define the HubSpot workflow names so PartnerOps can pick them up?
Lucy: Workflow names: CC_Marketplace_Leads, CC_Webinar_Signups, CC_Demo_Requests. I'll create them and share playbook.
PartnerOps Bot: Reminder: marketplace listing requirements: logo 1200x600, 1-page feature PDF, case study blurb (<=200 words), SOC2 link, contact email. Listing must be submitted 5 business days before publish.
Alejandro: Noted. I'll prepare assets. Also need a 60s demo video — can we do a short screen capture of the integration?
Sophie: For the benchmark blog, we should be explicit about test conditions: model name, quantization, sequence length, batching strategy, and cache settings. We should include a small table of p50/p95/p99 and cost-per-1k tokens with caveats.
Ben: Upload done: https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/cc-launch/benchmarks.csv — summary: p50=78ms, p95=220ms, p99=410ms; cost ~= $2.40 per 1k tokens (quantized config). Test config: redwood-3b-quant, seq_len=1024, dynamic batching up to 64, kv-prefix caching enabled.
Sophie: Great — I'll draft the blog and include a short TL;DR at the top and a benchmark methodology appendix. Draft link: https://docs.example.com/d/cc-blog-draft.
Maya: Social + marketing ops — can we get 2 social posts, 3 LinkedIn variations, and 3 short tweets scheduled for launch day? Also need a short one-paragraph partner blurb for partner PR.
Lucy: On it. I'll prepare the calendar (webinar + rehearsal + PR review). Also creating Zoom + registration page. Requesting co-host permissions from partner.
Alejandro: Partner also requested a joint press release. Partner PR wants to review copy by Apr 20. Can we aim to have final draft by Apr 19?
Maya: Yes — timeline: benchmarks + blog draft by Apr 10, marketplace assets by Apr 15, press draft by Apr 19, PR review by Apr 20, webinar on Apr 25, publish listing Apr 26.
Ben: Small technical note — when we publish benchmark numbers, include the command used to run the perf harness. Example: ```bash
./perf_runner --model redwood-3b-quant --seq 1024 --batching dynamic --max-batch 64 --prefix-cache on
```
Sophie: Good call. I'll paste that into the methodology. Also want to test two headline variations in the blog meta and track referral conversions separately.
Lucy: Routing mapping I'll set in HubSpot: marketplace_lead_owner = "Partner Marketing", lifecycle_stage = lead, inbound_channel = marketplace. For demo requests I'll include a hidden field: partner_id=cloudcatalog.
Maya: Ben — any blockers getting the benchmark artifacts?
Ben: No blockers, just need the final model config from Alejandro (confirm any tokenization differences).
Alejandro: Confirmed: tokenizer=bpe-v2, model=redwood-3b-quant, seq_len=1024.
Maya: Great. Can we do a 30-min prep session with partner on Apr 22 to walk the demo and press talking points? I'll send invite when Lucy confirms calendar.
Sophie: After I get the benchmarks I'll iterate the messaging and upload a headline + bullets doc for marketing review.
Lucy: Calendar invite created: Apr 22 11:00am PT — I invited partner PM and PR. I've also created the two landing pages and enabled A/B paths.
Maya: Awesome — thanks everyone. Final checklist: 1) Ben uploads final benchmark CSV and perf command; 2) Alejandro uploads marketplace assets + demo video; 3) Sophie publishes blog draft; 4) Lucy wires HubSpot workflows and landing pages; 5) PR draft ready by Apr 19. Next check-in: Fri 9:30am PT. :thumbsup:
Ben: :thumbsup:
Alejandro: :thumbsup:
Sophie: Sounds good.
Maya: If anything blocks, ping this thread.
